scope: Read-only source/design review of proposed cold-file-to-start_em and QNC/QNR preservation assertions. No raw runtime data, NetCDF payload, compiler, model, or test execution was inspected or performed.
source_assessment: The current host test confirms the NetCDF file has QNCCN/QNCLOUD/QNRAIN, but manufactures QNRAIN as zero. It joins QNCCN at START_PRE and applies the expected QNN startup guard result at START_POST; it does not currently join all three cold-file fields to START_PRE or check QNC/QNR preservation across START_POST and RESET_PRE/RESET_POST.

Pinned start_em.F startup code computes ccn_max_val from P_QNN and only writes P_QNN when ccn_max_val < 1.0 (around line 1803-1814). The inspected routine contains no QNC/QNR initialization or write. Thus the narrow proposed assertions can verify cold-file-to-start_em ingress for QNN/QNC/QNR, preserve the existing QNN initialization policy, and require QNC/QNR to remain unchanged across the startup guard.

Pinned module_microphysics_driver.F has a separate first-timestep option-37 reset that writes QNN_CURR=ccn_conc (around line 931); this is downstream of RK scalar updates and before the option-37 UDM call. The reset hook already brackets only that assignment. Checking QNC/QNR bits across RESET_PRE/RESET_POST is directly source-grounded; it verifies they are not changed by the QNN-only reset.

A manufactured finite positive QNR is a useful nonzero sentinel: it makes zero-fill, wrong-slot, or blanket-reset errors observable where the present zero QNR input cannot distinguish preservation from destructive zeroing. Distinct level/cell values make substitution or indexing mistakes easier to detect. This remains a test sentinel only; it does not validate units, number-population meaning, PSD consistency, process rates, or physical QNR positivity.
recommended_assertion_contract: For the selected observed column and each represented level, compare the actual input-file QNCCN/QNCLOUD/QNRAIN values to START_PRE using exact REAL32 bit patterns.

Across START_PRE→START_POST, assert QNC and QNR exact bit preservation. For QNN, preserve existing behavior: unchanged for positive/nonempty input, and only the already-declared ccn_conc initialization branch for the empty-QNN arm.

Across RESET_PRE→RESET_POST, assert QNC and QNR exact bit preservation while retaining the explicit QNN reset-to-ccn_conc expectation. Join RESET_POST to subsequent UDM_ENTRY for all three numbers if this is within the targeted call-path claim.

Use event bit words and the input variable’s REAL32 representation for bit checks; keep finite-value validation and do not introduce unit or magnitude acceptance thresholds beyond the manufactured sentinel setup.
limits: This closes only the tested selected-column cold-file ingress and preservation across the two named initialization/reset points. It does not prove every horizontal cell or every model phase preserves those fields.
A positive manufactured QNR strengthens test sensitivity but is not a physical initial-condition validation or approval of the current startup policy.
Whether production initialization policy should initialize or preserve any field remains OPEN and is outside this test-only assertion scope.
